summary: Adds a table/cards layout toggle, real in-flight operation visibility with an auto-expiry safety net, a fully bilingual (English/Arabic) panel, and table refresh after add/edit and enrollment.
highlights: Switch the fleet overview between a data table and informative cards, per user or a fleet-wide default.
In-flight operations show phase, elapsed time, agent online state, and an overdue flag instead of a bare badge.
Stuck operations past their deadline are auto-failed by a Celery-beat sweep, so the strip never hangs forever.
The whole fleet panel now translates to Arabic — table, cards, filters, modals, forms, and messages.
Add, edit, and enrollment modals refresh the fleet table so changes appear without a manual reload.
